info.title: officenet-mcp — create, edit, convert and preview Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF over MCP.
info.description:
An MCP server that lets AI assistants create, edit, convert and preview Word, Excel,
      PowerPoint and PDF documents through OfficeNet. Runs over stdio; every path is confined to
      one workspace directory. Install with `dotnet tool install -g Gravicode.OfficeNet.Mcp`.
      Dibuat oleh Gravicode Studios, dipimpin oleh Kang Fadhil.

options.name: --root
options.description:
Workspace. Paths are relative to it; nothing outside is touched.
Default: $OFFICENET_MCP_ROOT, else the current directory.

options.name: --read-only
options.description: Refuse every tool that would create or change a file.
